script_text:
Aquarius, this week overturns your fixed-air instinct to stay detached: money and intimacy force an unusually honest conversation.

On Monday, Mercury sextiles Saturn, your fixed-air ruler, in your 2nd House, favoring salary negotiations and disciplined budgeting. Tuesday's Moon opposes Uranus in your 12th, so an unexpected bill or secretive romantic complication can derail your plans.

Turning point: Wednesday's Moon enters Scorpio in your 10th House, redirecting your energy toward greater authority and concrete results at work.

Thursday through Sunday, Venus and Jupiter keep career opportunities moving. Saturday's full Moon in your 9th trines Pluto in your 1st, prompting a partner to answer your toughest relationship question.

Monday is your power day because Mercury sextiles Saturn in your 2nd House. Tuesday is your worst day because the Moon opposes Uranus in your 12th House.

Keep a firm boundary and two spending buffers.

Follow for daily updates.
